<repaired_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

using mint = long long;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

mint modpow(mint base, long long exp) {
    mint result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

mint modinv(mint a) {
    return modpow(a, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    std::cin >> n;

    vector<vector<mint>> p(n, vector<mint>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int pct;
            std::cin >> pct;
            p[i][j] = (mint)pct * modinv(100);
        }
    }

    // Generate all permutations of size n
    vector<vector<int>> perms;
    vector<int> perm(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) perm[i] = i;
    do {
        perms.push_back(perm);
    } while (next_permutation(perm.begin(), perm.end()));

    mint total = 0;

    for (auto& pmt : perms) {
        mint prob = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            prob *= p[i][pmt[i]];
        }
        total += prob;
    }

    cout << (int)(total % MOD) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
